Cyber Threat Protection Resource Get Security Exceptions
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cyberThreatProtection/securityExceptions

Retrieves information about the security exceptions configured for the ATP policy

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
bypassUrls
string[]
REQUIRED

Allowlist URLs that are not inspected by the ATP policy
